description: Source code for the AudioStreamInternal class in the Android AAudio framework, managing audio stream lifecycle, configuration, timestamps, and communication with the audio service.

classes.name: AudioStreamInternal
classes.description: Manages internal audio stream operations, including configuration, data processing, timestamp handling, and communication with the Android audio service.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the audio stream with specified builder parameters, configuring hardware and service descriptors.

methods.name: configureDataInformation
methods.description: Configures data queue and timing parameters based on hardware descriptors and callback settings.

methods.name: release_l
methods.description: Releases the audio stream, stopping it if active and closing associated resources.

methods.name: exitStandby_l
methods.description: Exits standby mode, restoring data queue and endpoint configurations.

methods.name: requestStart_l
methods.description: Starts the audio stream, handling standby exit if necessary, and initiates callback thread.

methods.name: calculateReasonableTimeout
methods.description: Calculates a timeout duration based on frames per operation to wait for processing.

methods.name: calculateReasonableTimeout()
methods.description: Overloaded version that uses frames per burst for timeout calculation.

methods.name: stopCallback_l
methods.description: Stops the data callback thread if active.

methods.name: requestStop_l
methods.description: Stops the audio stream, updating state and stopping service stream.

methods.name: registerThread
methods.description: Registers the current thread with the audio service for real-time processing.

methods.name: unregisterThread
methods.description: Unregisters the current thread from the audio service.

methods.name: startClient
methods.description: Starts an audio client with specified attributes.

methods.name: stopClient
methods.description: Stops an audio client identified by port handle.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the latest hardware or service timestamp for the stream.

methods.name: logTimestamp
methods.description: Logs timestamp information for debugging.

methods.name: onTimestampService
methods.description: Handles timestamp messages from the service.

methods.name: onTimestampHardware
methods.description: Handles hardware timestamp messages.

methods.name: onEventFromServer
methods.description: Processes events received from the audio service, such as start, pause, stop, volume, and disconnection.

methods.name: drainTimestampsFromService
methods.description: Clears timestamp messages from the service queue.

methods.name: processCommands
methods.description: Processes all queued commands and messages from the service.

methods.name: processData
methods.description: Handles data transfer, blocking if necessary, with timeout management.

methods.name: processTimestamp
methods.description: Processes and updates timestamp data.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Adjusts the buffer size within hardware and application constraints.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns current buffer size in frames.

methods.name: getBufferCapacity
methods.description: Returns maximum buffer capacity in frames.

methods.name: isClockModelInControl
methods.description: Checks if the clock model is actively controlling timing.
